Area.evidence_source: The main finding of this study is that according to the participants suicidal thoughts following sexual violence are based on a strong self-destructive force which creates almost unbearable unexpressed suffering which shapes their life and health. This strong self-destructive force appeared, for example as risk behaviour and negligence towards own personal life and health which can become life-threatening. The suicidal thoughts were an escape from recurrent thoughts about the sexual violence and revolved around finding inner stillness and peace.
